description.value:
This upgrade gathers the target's biological data and displays it on an autorecognition lens or other heads-up display on the wielder's armor or weapon.

Activate—Scan Complete f

Trigger You hit or critically hit on a Strike with the weapon

Effect You @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Recall Knowledge] about the Strike's target, with a +1 circumstance bonus to your skill check to do so. If you critically hit on the triggering Strike, you get a +2 circumstance bonus instead. The target is then temporarily immune to Scan Complete for 1 day.
